info.name: Card Show Scanner - Public Price and Opportunities Diagnostics
info.description: Three independent read-only requests: public exact-SKU pricing, Beta Opportunities index, Beta exact-SKU market insights. No Research dependency. Import the existing empty TCGTracking-Local environment, set local tcgt_shipper_id/tcgt_beta_key if available, and Run collection once in order. Public results remain available if Beta credentials/access/coverage are missing. Defaults: Pokemon category 3, known group22872, Charmander SV Promo044 product512035, EN Holofoil Near Mint. Edit tcgt_market_* collection variables for another target; the group never changes automatically. Live coverage for this example is unknown. HTTP success and exact SKU coverage have separate tests/statuses. No credentials/raw error bodies are logged or included in tcgt_market_summary. Do not share populated credential environments or request headers.

exec: const target = {category_id: get('category_id'), group_id: get('group_id'), product_id: get('product_id'), card_name: get('card_name'), set_name: get('set_name'), language: get('language'), printing: get('printing'), condition: get('condition')};
'Public pricing is independent of Beta credentials and Research.',
'Opps coverage is not a complete record of sales or stock; missing coverage does not mean zero.',
'pricing.avg_30d may fall back to a market average. Only explicitly named tcg_sold_avg fields are sold averages.',
'This diagnostic does not establish physical authenticity or a PSA grade.'

const languages = {EN: 'English', JP: 'Japanese', FR: 'French', DE: 'German', IT: 'Italian', ES: 'Spanish', PT: 'Portuguese', RU: 'Russian', KO: 'Korean', CS: 'Simplified Chinese', CT: 'Traditional Chinese'};
const conditions = {NM: 'Near Mint', LP: 'Lightly Played', MP: 'Moderately Played', HP: 'Heavily Played', DMG: 'Damaged', Unopened: 'Unopened'};
skip('Use supported category, canonical numeric group/product, exact language code, full printing and condition code.');
for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(target)) pm.variables.set('tcgt_market_' + key, value);
const expectedURL = section === 'public' ? publicURL : section === 'beta_index' ? metaURL : oppsURL;
if (pm.variables.replaceIn(pm.request.url.toString()) !== expectedURL) skip('Unexpected endpoint: only the exact fixed public/Beta URL is allowed.');
// An unauthenticated fixed-host request still produces a response
// for request 03's Visualize pane, while public results survive.
const record = value => value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
const scalar = value => value === null || typeof value === 'boolean' || (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) || (typeof value === 'string' && value.length <= 512);

const numeric = value => value === undefined || value === null || (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) || (typeof value === 'string' && /^-?[0-9]{1,20}(?:\.[0-9]{1,8})?$/.test(value));
const pick = (value, keys) => Object.fromEntries(keys.filter(key => Object.hasOwn(value, key) && scalar(value[key])).map(key => [key, value[key]]));
const fail = (name, condition) => pm.test(name, () => { if (!condition) throw new Error(name); });
const label = publicRequest ? 'Public SKU' : metaRequest ? 'Beta opportunities index' : 'Beta exact SKU';
// Never log provider bodies, headers or credentials. Share only this
// allowlisted summary. Redact an echoed API key as an extra safeguard.
const serialized = JSON.stringify(summary, (_, value) => typeof value === 'string' && key.length >= 16 ? value.split(key).join('[redacted]') : value, 2);

if (!publicRequest && !metaRequest) pm.visualizer.set('

Public price + exact SKU market insights

Null or missing values are unavailable. Zero is a returned value. Missing Beta coverage does not mean zero sales or stock. avg_30d can be a market-average fallback.

{{summary}}
', {summary: serialized});
try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (_) { result.status = 'invalid_response'; fail(label + ' valid JSON/schema', false); finish(); return; }
function invalid(status = 'invalid_response') { result.status = status; fail(label + ' valid identity/schema', false); finish(); }

const languages = {EN: 'English', JP: 'Japanese', FR: 'French', DE: 'German', IT: 'Italian', ES: 'Spanish', PT: 'Portuguese', RU: 'Russian', KO: 'Korean', CS: 'Simplified Chinese', CT: 'Traditional Chinese'};
const conditions = {NM: 'Near Mint', LP: 'Lightly Played', MP: 'Moderately Played', HP: 'Heavily Played', DMG: 'Damaged', Unopened: 'Unopened'};
const conditionIDs = {NM: 1, LP: 2, MP: 3, HP: 4, DMG: 5, Unopened: 6};
if (!record(category) || !record(category.sets)) { result.status = 'category_not_indexed'; fail('Target category is indexed for opportunities', false); finish(); return; }
if (category.category_id !== undefined && category.category_id !== Number(target.category_id)) { invalid('identity_mismatch'); return; }
const matches = Object.entries(category.sets).filter(([key, row]) => id(key) && record(row) && row.set_name === target.set_name);
if (selected === undefined) { result.status = 'set_not_indexed'; fail('Requested group is indexed for opportunities', false); finish(); return; }

if (!record(selected) || (selected.group_id !== undefined && selected.group_id !== Number(target.group_id)) || (selected.category_id !== undefined && selected.category_id !== Number(target.category_id))) { invalid('identity_mismatch'); return; }
fail('Requested group is indexed for opportunities', true); finish(); return;
if (body.set_id !== Number(target.group_id) || (body.category_id !== undefined && body.category_id !== Number(target.category_id))) { invalid('identity_mismatch'); return; }
if (body.meta.category_id !== Number(target.category_id) || body.meta.group_id !== Number(target.group_id)) { invalid('identity_mismatch'); return; }
result.status = 'product_missing'; fail('Exact product ' + target.product_id + ' is present', false); finish(); return;
if (!publicRequest && (product.product_id !== Number(target.product_id) || typeof product.name !== 'string' || !record(product.skus))) { invalid('invalid_product'); return; }
typeof row.cnd !== 'string' || typeof row.var !== 'string' || typeof row.lng !== 'string' :

!Number.isInteger(row.condition_id) || row.condition_id < 1 || row.condition_id > 6 || row.condition !== Object.values(conditions)[row.condition_id - 1] || typeof row.finish !== 'string' || typeof row.language !== 'string'))) { invalid('invalid_sku'); return; }
const exact = entries.filter(([key, row]) => publicRequest ? row.cnd === target.condition && row.var === target.printing && row.lng === target.language :
row.condition_id === conditionIDs[target.condition] && row.condition === conditions[target.condition] && row.finish === target.printing && row.language === languages[target.language]);
if (!chosen) { result.status = 'sku_missing'; fail('Exact public SKU and full variant are covered by Beta', false); finish(); return; }
if (exact.length !== 1) { result.status = exact.length ? 'sku_ambiguous' : 'sku_missing'; fail('Exactly one full variant SKU exists', false); finish(); return; }
fail('Exact product ' + target.product_id + ' and unique selected SKU are present', true);
for (const key of ['pricing', 'timestamps', 'marketplaces', 'trends']) if (row[key] !== undefined && row[key] !== null && !record(row[key])) { invalid(); return; }

if (!record(market) || (market.listings !== undefined && market.listings !== null && (!Array.isArray(market.listings) || market.listings.length > 20 || market.listings.some(item => !record(item))))) { invalid(); return; }

item.name: 01 - Public exact SKU price and listing context

request.description: Public, credential-free condition/printing/language pricing. Clears prior results when starting a new collection run.

item.name: 02 - Beta opportunities index, optional set check

request.description: Reports exact set-name/index coverage only. Never changes the configured group or gates requests 01/03. No Research endpoint is used.

item.name: 03 - Beta exact SKU pricing, listings and sales windows

request.description: Validates exact set/product/SKU and full variant. Writes tcgt_market_summary; open Visualize for a shareable formatted summary. Null/missing values are unavailable; zero is preserved.
